evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen and tube pressure sensors are not installed; purge effectiveness and growth atmosphere/pressure cannot be verified.
Growth readings are T=749.6 °C versus 750 °C setpoint, Ar=100.1 sccm versus 100 sccm setpoint, heater power=44.8%, and status=running; measured temperature and inlet flow track setpoints.
Initial growth temperature reached 760.3 °C, then settled near the 750 °C setpoint by 2760 s; no acceptance tolerance is provided.

args.missing_evidence: Independent measurements of tube pressure and exhaust oxygen to verify growth conditions and purge effectiveness; temperature acceptance limits to evaluate the initial overshoot; sample characterization to determine whether the target grew.
